FAA finds Boeing 737 Max software glitch poses no safety risk

The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has determined that a software glitch affecting certain flight computers on Boeing's 737 Max 10 aircraft does not pose a safety risk. This finding provides a boost to the certification process for the 737 Max 10.
